summary: Created plan v5 for route (1): a driver-dependent Hintikka/canonical-model truth lemma with a PINNED witness model, at full branchSatisfiableIn s4FC strength. v4 stamped [ABANDONED] with a Superseded-by pointer, preserving its Phase 1/2 [COMPLETED] status, its Phase 3 Verdict, and its Post-Gate-B Triage note (Phase 4's stale [IN PROGRESS] marker corrected to [NOT STARTED] with a record-correction note, since it was never dispatched). Route (1) rests on two mechanisms, neither of which any prior route had: (1) accPinnedBy, an upper bound on the witness relation over branch labels, which turns 'ambient predecessor of f src' -- the uncontrollable set that killed Route P, the origin-edge revision, and ancestor-only blocking -- into 'acc-ancestor of src'; and (2) boxed birth content plus a boxed mint payload (report 02 section 4's R-new, never yet tested against this obligation), which makes the transfer at the redirect target WRAPPED rather than unwrapped, dissolving the exact defect that killed route (3). Grounded in ChagrovZakharyaschev1997: the interval theorem S_min subset S subset S_max (chunk_0246), whose explicit warning that a relation in the interval may be nontransitive even when R is transitive PREDICTS route (3)'s failure; the Lemmon filtration's box-plus (chunk_0248), which is exactly wrapped-plus-unwrapped; and Theorem 5.51 (chunk_0267/0268), whose model relation IS the reflexive-transitive closure of generated edges with the containment S_{n+1} subset R_ambient -- the literature form of accPinnedBy. Risk is front-loaded into FOUR kill gates: three in wave 1 with fully disjoint territory (Phase 1 owns FrameSoundness.lean, Phase 2 owns LoopChecking.lean, Phase 3 owns specs artifacts), Gate D in wave 2. Each has a written kill table, a one-dispatch attempt budget, and a no-sorry-at-a-gate rule. Phases 5-12 are explicitly NOT scaffolded on a positive verdict. Honest terminal condition stated in the plan: if any gate fails, do NOT propose a fifth route -- conclude the apparatus needs restructuring and hand off to task 557, which requires inverting 557's dependency on 553.
next_action_hint: Dispatch wave 1 -- Phases 1, 2 and 3 in parallel; their territory is fully disjoint (FrameSoundness.lean / LoopChecking.lean / specs artifacts respectively) so no same-file serialisation is needed. Running all three maximises the probability of an EARLY KILL, which is the goal given four prior route failures. All three must return positive verdicts before Phase 4, and all four gates must pass before any of Phases 5-12 is dispatched. Gate B (Phase 2) is the likeliest to fail: modalHintikkaClauseGen returns True for every box/diamond-shaped formula regardless of sign, so the landed S4KeyedHintikkaInv.hintikkaInv supplies nothing for T(box psi) / F(dia psi) -- precisely the shapes Gate A consumes. Do not let Phase 3's measurements, however clean, license a reordering or a softened kill criterion: v3 measured 1374/1374 and died at its gate, and route (3) measured 0/24314 and died at its gate.
